readerCopy.headline: The bigger idea meets another point of view.
readerCopy.body:
Someone may have a different answer and enough evidence to make you stop. A negotiation can widen because each person is solving a different problem. You may both sound completely reasonable while using different assumptions, dates, or definitions underneath the conversation.

Jupiter opposing Mercury can make each side more certain because each side can see a larger story. Do not answer volume with volume. Find the fact, deadline, term, or decision that actually changes the outcome. You may still disagree after that, but at least you will know what the disagreement is.
doNotAssume: Do not assume lying, incompetence, legal conflict, or that one perspective is automatically correct.
